mapper.insert: INSERT INTO faq_entry (question, answer, keywords, category, source_doc, heading_path, hit_count, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{question}, #{answer}, #{keywords}, #{category}, #{sourceDoc}, #{headingPath}, 0, 'active', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE faq_entry SET question = #{question}, answer = #{answer}, keywords = #{keywords}, category = #{category}, source_doc = #{sourceDoc}, heading_path = #{headingPath}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM faq_entry WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY hit_count DESC
SELECT * FROM faq_entry WHERE category = #{category} AND status = 'active' ORDER BY hit_count DESC
SELECT * FROM faq_entry WHERE status = 'active' AND (question ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR keywords ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY hit_count DESC
SELECT * FROM faq_entry WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY hit_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE faq_entry SET hit_count = hit_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: UPDATE faq_entry SET status = 'deleted', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
